notes: Eclipse Loop 2.5.6 - a day of fixes found by using the app. MIDI tracks voiced by a plugin synth arrived LATE, because delay compensation counted your effects and never the instrument. STOP left the notes ringing. Dumping a lead to the arranger produced the wrong notes, four different ways. Closing a plugin window after loading a project could crash. A hung audio device could make Loop unlaunchable. The Arrange window burned 41% CPU sitting idle. And the playhead now rolls until you press STOP, like every other DAW.
